questions.stem:
Mom: The dishes have been in the sink for two days.

Son: I'll get to them after I finish this.

What might the parent infer?
options: The teen has already done them.
The teen has been delaying the task.
The teen is busy with something urgent.
questions.explanation: Two days suggests delay; teen's response indicates postponement.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "Could you take out the trash? It's overflowing." What does 'overflowing' mean?
options: So full that contents spill or exceed the container.
questions.explanation: Overflowing means too full, spilling over.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Brother: I'll vacuum if you mop. Deal?

You: ---

Which response agrees to the division of labour?
options: Deal! I'll start in the kitchen.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "The laundry needs to be folded before it wrinkles." What might happen if you wait?
options: The clothes may wrinkle and need ironing.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Dad: Who left the milk out?

Son: ---

Which response shows accountability?
options: Sorry, that was me. I'll put it back.
I don't know what you mean.
questions.explanation: Taking responsibility and correcting the mistake.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "Run a load of laundry" — What does this mean?
options: Start a wash cycle in the washing machine.
questions.explanation: Run a load means do a wash cycle.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Roommate: The fridge needs cleaning. It's your turn.

You: ---

Which response acknowledges the task?
options: You're right. I'll do it this weekend.
questions.explanation: Acknowledges turn and commits to doing it.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "Don't leave wet towels on the floor—they'll mildew." What is the warning?
options: Wet towels left on the floor can develop mould/mildew.
questions.explanation: Wet fabric in a heap can develop mildew.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem:
Dad: The yard could use a mow.

What is Dad suggesting?
questions.explanation: Could use a mow means the grass needs mowing.
questions.subject: ing

questions.stem: "I'll do the grocery run if you pick up the dry cleaning." What is the arrangement?
options: Tasks are divided: one shops, the other collects dry cleaning.
questions.explanation: Division of errands between two people.
questions.subject: ing
